settings.title: Workflows
settings.heading: Workflows
settings.description: Control which state transitions each role is allowed to make in this project.

jp_workflows.load_error: Could not load the workflow rules. Please try again.
jp_workflows.no_states: This project has no states yet.
jp_workflows.admin_note: Admins can always move work items to any state.

enable.title: Enforce workflow
enable.description: When on, members and guests can only make the state changes checked for their role (a role without rules stays unrestricted). Agents always follow their rules.
enable.error: Could not update the workflow. Please try again.
enable.off_notice: The workflow is off: only the agent rules are enforced.

no_rules.member: No rules: members can move work items between any states.
no_rules.agent: No rules: agents use the default To Do → In Progress → In Review.
no_rules.guest: No rules: guests are not restricted by the workflow.

matrix.caption: Allowed state changes for {role}
matrix.same_state: Staying in the same state is always allowed
matrix.count: {count, plural, one {1 allowed transition} other {{count} allowed transitions}}

epics.title: Apply to epics
epics.description: When off, these rules don't apply to epics, so this role can't change the state of epics.
epics.mixed: Some of these rules apply to epics and some don't. Toggling updates all of them.
epics.agent_locked: Agents can never change the state of epics.

toast.save_error: Could not save the workflow rules.
